scope: Bounded manual source inventory of selected local solver harnesses and containment helpers; not an exhaustive repository or runtime process inventory.

observations.termination_requested: drain_owned requests TerminateJobObject when members or the root remain; cleanup_owned also handles an unassigned root.
observations.root_exited: drain_owned observes the retained root handle separately from job accounting.
observations.whole_owned_job_drained: active_processes queries ActiveProcesses while the job remains open; drain_owned requires both an empty job and an exited root.
observations.cleanup_unknown: Query, termination, deadline and close errors propagate; Model mode sets cleanup_state unknown before each phase.

entries.follow_up: Retain the repaired issue #2093 contract; qualify actual operating-system behavior separately.

observations.termination_requested: WindowsSupervisor.terminate requests job termination after assignment or direct-root kill after failed assignment.
observations.root_exited: WindowsSupervisor.wait and close wait on the launched process.
observations.whole_owned_job_drained: _settle polls supervisor.active before close; WindowsJob.active queries job accounting using a retained handle.
observations.cleanup_unknown: _settle records unknown member counts on errors and retains unsettled supervisors in an in-memory dictionary.

entries.follow_up: Review restart persistence and resource-release consumers before treating in-memory retention as a durable interlock.

observations.termination_requested: PosixSupervisor.terminate signals the process group while retaining the unreaped leader.
observations.root_exited: PosixSupervisor.wait uses waitid without reaping until close.
observations.whole_owned_job_drained: active scans the original group and excludes zombies; escaped descendants are outside that census. containment_verified is false.
observations.cleanup_unknown: _settle retains unresolved supervisors, but group absence cannot establish whole-owned-tree absence.

entries.follow_up: Preserve the explicit unqualified containment status; require an approved containment design before reuse qualification.

observations.termination_requested: Owned.cleanup closes the kill-on-close job; cleanup_failed_launch can request direct-root termination.
observations.root_exited: Owned.cleanup waits only on the root handle after closing the job.
observations.whole_owned_job_drained: The helper alone has no drain query. Resources.close_all additionally waits retained identities and requires complete_census with no pending creation.
observations.cleanup_unknown: Resources.close_all refuses confirmation on errors or incomplete census; the qualification journal preserves unfinished stages. The live capture backend is disabled.

entries.follow_up: Do not generalize the root-only helper to arbitrary solvers; review census completeness and crash paths together with its caller.

observations.termination_requested: _terminate invokes taskkill on Windows or signals a POSIX group; fallback requests direct-root kill on Windows.
observations.root_exited: _solve and _terminate wait for the launched child.
observations.whole_owned_job_drained: No retained Job Object or complete descendant census is present in these functions, including normal completion before readback.
observations.cleanup_unknown: Root wait failures can propagate; successful root wait does not establish descendant absence or a persistent cleanup interlock.

entries.follow_up: Prepare a reviewed containment-and-drain change before this route can supply whole-process cleanup evidence.

observations.termination_requested: _phase2_orcawave_execution has no explicit tree termination or process budget around the batch invocation.
observations.root_exited: subprocess.run waits for the shell-launched batch process and checks its return code.
observations.whole_owned_job_drained: The inspected method supplies no whole-job drain observation before later phases.
observations.cleanup_unknown: Exceptions return failure but no explicit cleanup-unknown state or durable interlock is established here.

entries.follow_up: Review shell and batch ownership plus timeout behavior before proposing cleanup changes.

observations.termination_requested: The external-force failure path terminates the launched root when still running.
observations.root_exited: The synchronous utility uses subprocess.run; the external-force caller waits on the launch-only Popen before the next iteration.
observations.whole_owned_job_drained: Neither inspected route supplies a whole-job membership/drain query; the external-force root wait has no timeout.
observations.cleanup_unknown: Root or server failures do not establish descendant absence; explicit cleanup uncertainty and restart quarantine are not established here.

entries.follow_up: Plan the external server and solver lifetime together, retaining the existing explicit native opt-in.

observations.termination_requested: run_cases cancels pending futures on shutdown; this is not an observed whole-process termination result.
observations.root_exited: Future completion is observed for submitted work; broken pools use shutdown with wait false before possible replacement.
observations.whole_owned_job_drained: The inspected scheduler has no Job Object census; in-process native calls and broken-worker replacement need a separate ownership analysis.
observations.cleanup_unknown: Worker exceptions produce infrastructure-fault records; these records do not assert whole-owned-job drain.

entries.follow_up: Review broken-pool replacement and native worker lifetime before proposing any scheduler change.

observations.termination_requested: _terminate_group signals the original process group; ProcessLookupError and PermissionError return without a drain result.
observations.root_exited: _process_alive checks the recorded root PID; poll_detached_run sets running false and terminated true after the termination helper returns.
observations.whole_owned_job_drained: No complete descendant census or empty-group observation accompanies that result.
observations.cleanup_unknown: The terminated flag records the helper path, not confirmed owned-tree absence. Detached execution intentionally returns before completion.

entries.follow_up: Treat as an unlicensed comparison case; plan identity-bound group observation before strengthening termination claims.

observations.termination_requested: solve delegates process timeout handling to subprocess.run.
observations.whole_owned_job_drained: The inspected method has no explicit descendant containment or whole-job drain query.
observations.cleanup_unknown: A subprocess timeout is not a whole-tree cleanup receipt.
